suppliersHint: Everyone you buy from, with what you owe them.
requestsHint: Ask to buy stock. Once approved, a request becomes an order.
ordersHint: What you have ordered from suppliers and what is still to arrive.
receiptsHint: Each delivery you have received. Stock is added when you confirm one.
billsHint: Invoices from suppliers: enter, check against what you ordered and received, then pay.
returnsHint: Goods you sent back to suppliers.
creditNotesHint: Credit that suppliers gave you against their bills.
refundsHint: Money suppliers owe back after a paid bill was credited, and refunds already received.
payablesHint: What you owe suppliers on posted bills, by how late it is.
paySuppliersHint: Choose a supplier, tick the bills to pay and pay them in one go.
name: Name
codeHint: Your short code for this supplier.
termsHint: Days after the bill date that payment is due. 0 means on receipt.
statusHint: On hold or inactive suppliers cannot be ordered from or paid.
costsBeforeTax: Costs are before tax. Tax is added for you when you save.
previewNote: estimate; the saved document shows the exact totals
noSuppliersHint: Add the people and companies you buy from, then you can order and enter their bills.
bankProcess: To protect you from fraud, changes to payment details take three steps: one person proposes, a different person confirms with the supplier directly, then it is approved.
bankProposeWarn: Nothing changes until someone else confirms these details with the supplier. Only the last four digits are ever shown.
noBankHint: Propose the supplier's bank or mobile money account.
bankProposed: Proposed. Someone else must now confirm it with the supplier.
bankConfirmed: Confirmed. It now waits for approval.
confirmBankHint: Contact the supplier yourself, using a number you already had, and check the account ending {{number}}.
priceHistoryHint: What this supplier has charged, newest first.
noPricesHint: Prices appear here after you receive goods from this supplier.
statementHint: Bills, credit notes and refunds for this supplier.
noStatement: Nothing recorded with this supplier yet.
statementLimit: Showing up to the latest 100 of each. Payments are shown on each bill.
reconcileHint: Paste the statement they sent you. We mark each line as matched, different or missing from your books. Nothing is changed.
statementFormat: One line each: date,reference,kind,amount. Kind is invoice, credit or payment.
theirBalanceHint: Optional: the balance their statement shows.
asOfHint: Default: date of their last line.
missingThere: We have it, they do not
missingThereHint: Items in our books that their statement does not show.
noReconcilePermission: You need permission to enter supplier bills to check statements.
approvalWaiting: Waiting for approval by someone with the right role.
approvalYours: This is waiting for your decision.
orderFormHint: Choose the supplier and what you want to buy. Save it as a draft, then send it for approval.
noOrdersHint: Create an order when you buy stock from a supplier.
draftOrderHint: This is a draft. Submit it for approval when it is ready; nothing is ordered until then.

cancel.title: Cancel this order?
cancel.message: Order {{number}} will be cancelled. This cannot be undone.

close.title: Close this order?
close.message: You will stop waiting for the rest of order {{number}}.

noReceiptsForOrder: Nothing received against this order yet.
noRequestsHint: Staff can ask to buy stock here; a manager approves it and it becomes an order.
receiptFormHint: Record goods that arrived without an order.
deliveryNoteHint: The number on the supplier's delivery note.
landedCostHint: Extra costs of getting the goods here, shared across the lines.
partialOk: Receive only what arrived; the rest stays on the order.
zeroSkips: Leave a line at 0 if it did not arrive.
noReceiptsHint: Receive goods against an order, or on their own.
returnHint: Choose how much of each item goes back. The stock leaves straight away.
noReturnsHint: Return damaged or wrong goods from a receipt.
creditAfterReturn: When the supplier sends a credit note for these goods, record it on the bill.
billFormHint: Copy the supplier's invoice. Add the goods from a receipt so it can be checked against what you ordered and received.
theirInvoiceHint: Each invoice number can be entered once per supplier.
dueDateHint: Leave empty to use the supplier's payment terms.
authorityRefHint: Optional: the reference the tax authority gave the invoice.
billLinesHint: Add the goods on this invoice from a receipt, plus any transport, duty or other charges.
noSupplierReceipts: No deliveries received from this supplier yet.
billedAlreadyNote: Check quantities: goods that were already billed cannot be billed again.
noBillsHint: Enter each supplier invoice so you know what you owe and when.
draftBillHint: This is a draft. Submit it to check it against the order and receipt and post it.
reverseBillHint: Use this when the bill was entered wrongly. The books are put back as they were. It cannot be done while the bill has payments or credit notes.

submit.title: Submit this bill?
submit.message: Bill {{number}} will be checked against the order and receipt, and posted if it matches. After this its lines cannot be changed.

matchFailed: This bill does not match what was ordered and received.
exceptionSeparate: Someone other than the person who entered it must accept it, with a reason, or send it back to be corrected.
exceptionWaiting: It waits for a person with approval rights.
reversePaymentHint: The payment is cancelled and the bill is owed again.
spreadHint: Fills the amounts oldest bill first.
pickSupplierToPay: Choose a supplier to see the bills you owe them.
nothingToPayHint: This supplier has no unpaid posted bills.
confirmPaymentsMessage: You are about to pay {{count}} bill(s) to {{supplier}}, {{total}} in all. This records the payments in your books.
paymentsStopped: Stopped after {{count}} payment(s). See the result column.
creditForGoods: Credit for goods you sent back
noSupplierReturns: No goods have been returned to this supplier.
creditLinesHint: Add the goods returned, or another credit the supplier gave.
noCreditNotesHint: Record them on the bill when a supplier gives you credit.
refundsDueHint: Paid bills that were later credited, so the supplier owes you money.
reverseRefundHint: Use this when the money did not arrive. The supplier owes it again.
owingNothingHint: Posted bills that are unpaid appear here.
nothingDueSoon: No bills due in the next 7 days.
noAccountCanAdd: Add one now and this payment can go through it.
noAccountSetUpIn: Set one up in Payments, then come back.
noAccountAskOwner: Ask the owner or someone who manages payment accounts to add one, then come back.
payAcctNameHint: What you call it, for example Main bank account.
payAcctNumberHint: Optional. Only the last digits, so it is recognisable. The full number is never kept.
noLocationYet: There is no stock location to receive into yet.
